decision: Move 'cooling sheets queen' to Ranking objective, fixed bid $2.24, Top-of-Search +75% (the plan's setting).
evidence: Queen's biggest keyword (5.7 of Queen's 13.5 planned clicks a day). Now Conversion with down-only bids: top-of-search share 0.21%, 28% of budget used, organic #68.
gate: None: it restores the plan's setting.

decision: Re-point Queen ads from Queen White to Queen Graphite.
evidence: Graphite: 400 units, #1 Queen colour for both sister brands; the Batch 2 gate is measured on Queen Graphite. White: 197 units. This week's colour CVRs (White 1/38, Graphite 3/28) are too small to decide on alone.
gate: None: plan SKU; check cover the same day.

decision: Add negative exact for 'cooling sheets queen' in Queen Tail 18 and 'cooling queen sheets' in Queen Tail 22.
evidence: 4 of 16 and 1 of 2 clicks went to the tails through close-variant matching.

decision: Negatives for unrelated searches: silk, tencel, comforter and blanket, bed-fan and cooling-device searches, apartment essentials, sleep number; 'sleephoria' as negative phrase.
evidence: About $35 of clicks on searches for other products or our sister brand.

decision: Launch the cooling-sheet branded exact ('coolinens', Queen Graphite, $10/day); negative exact 'coolinens' in the pillowcase-page product targeting.
evidence: Brand searches now show pillowcase ads (7 clicks).

decision: No change to King: no bid, budget or targeting changes.
evidence: King SP: 13 orders, ACoS 40% over 4 days, but 9 of the 13 orders came on 18 Oct; without that day ACoS is 87%. King units: 4, 10, 19, 4 vs a 4.3 baseline.
gate: 7 full days: King SP ACoS ≤ 43.7% with orders on at least 4 of 7 days. Then decide with Zarlish whether King is assigned to CooLinens (push) or capped.

decision: Keep rival-page campaigns running (only the relevance negatives in D04).
evidence: 29 clicks, 0 orders: a 17% chance at 6% CVR, so not proof of failure. Decolure's history on rival pages: 42% ACoS.
gate: 50 clicks per campaign or 30 Oct. Exit a target at 0 orders on 50 clicks (under 2% chance at 8% CVR).

decision: Keep Auto at its low bid; no ranking-keyword negatives yet.
evidence: $3.10, 4 clicks. Sleephoria's Auto ran at 6.3% ACoS. Auto has not bought any ranking keyword.
gate: Add a ranking-keyword wall only if Auto carries more than 40% of any ranking keyword's clicks.

decision: Hold bids and modifiers; apply the plan's weekly rules on 27 Oct.
evidence: Spend runs about $257/day vs the plan's $138; ranking-keyword Top-of-Search modifiers +65% to +302%. Four days are too few for the plan's REDUCE rule.
gate: Plan rule: step the modifier down 25 points where ACoS is above the ranking ceiling for 2 weeks, or CVR is under 60% of plan on 50+ clicks.

decision: Queen conversion check after D01–D02 have run for 7 days.
evidence: Queen SP: 1 order on 50 clicks (a 6% chance at plan CVR), on the White listing at $87.99 vs the plan's $79.99.
gate: If Queen CVR is still under 5.3% (60% of plan) on 50+ clicks after the changes: review price and listing before adding spend.

decision: Keep SBV running; judge the Queen rival video at 30 clicks; re-plan the SBV test around the new video (studio 26 Oct).
evidence: SBV King rival video 3 orders at 18% ACoS; Queen rival video 15 clicks, 0 orders (29% chance).
gate: 30 clicks on the Queen video, or 26 Oct.

decision: Change the Full ad SKU to Midnight Black (or Cool Grey) and Cal King to Graphite this week.
evidence: Live Full Cream (29 units) and Cal King Regal Purple (30 units) are the weakest sellers for the sister brand; Full Midnight Black sold 9 units at 16.7% with no ads.

decision: Superseded: the earlier proposals to pause product targeting, Auto and SBV Broad and to cut modifiers now.
evidence: Four days of data cannot separate a weak campaign from normal early variation (see D07–D09).
gate: Replaced by D07, D08, D09, D11.
